scientific_integrity: The unrestricted identities are derived from dyadic square-root counts and a separate collision argument. Finite exhaustive checks for k=2..10 and four Fourier computations are corroborative only; no arbitrary-weight sharp extension inequality is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The statement is limited to unweighted full two-sum fibers and the constant-input joint fourth Fourier moment on (Z/2^kZ)^2, k>=2. An independent mathematical or priority audit has not been performed. The full text of Zhang (2011) was unavailable for complete coverage inspection.
title: Complete dyadic modular-hyperbola two-sum fibers and Kloosterman fourth moments
